verdict.rationale: Mem0's core design explicitly supports cross-session persistence — memories are scoped by user/agent/app/session and searched via natural-language queries to inject relevant past context before the next model call (mem0-docs-30, mem0-docs-43, mem0-probe-1). However, Mem0 stores discrete extracted facts rather than narrative session summaries, and a community comparison explicitly notes it is 'key-value memory with semantic search,' not full conversational summarization (mem0-comm-7, mem0-docs-26). Missing for 10: dedicated session/thread summarization feature (vs. fact extraction), and independent hands-on evidence that agents reliably 'pick up where they left off' using this mechanism.
